LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 15.3.1 SENTENCES- 15.3.1.1 IMPERATIVE – COMMANDS, REQUESTS 15.3.1.2 EXCLAMATORY

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.3: Grammar in use 15.3.1 Sentences- 15.3.1.1 Imperative – commands, requests 15.3.1.2 Exclamatory
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in use 15.3.1 Sentences- 15.3.1.1 Imperative – commands, requests 15.3.1.2 Exclamatory, part of Strand 15 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do you decide whether to use an exclamation mark or a period at the end of a sentence?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify signs of words related to the theme,

   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. appreciate the use of exclamatory and imperative sentences in spoken language. • In groups or pairs learner is guided to observe, fingerspell and signs of words related to the theme. • In groups, learner who is Hard of Hearing is guided to orally list the kinds of rules that they would want. • Learner who Deaf is guided to list the kinds of rules that they would want implemented in their school. • Individually, learner is guided to identify and label sentence types in printed handouts or online texts. • Individually, learner is guided to construct signed imperative sentences as they respond to teacher’s questions. SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in use 15.3.1 Sentences- 15.3.1.1 Imperative – commands, requests 15.3.1.2 Exclamatory together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy: interacting with technology skill as learner using digital devices to identify and label sentence types from

online texts.

• Learning to learn: learners independently construct imperative sentences.

Values:
Social justice: learners compare societal issues through discussing rules in school.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Learner Support Programme- Problem solving: learners work in pairs/groups to construct exclamatory sentences
